name: Alby Pringle
bioAdditions: The 1840 census of Plymouth Twp shows a boy aged 15-20 in James Pringle's household, which fits Alby, who was 27 in 1850 (born about 1823) (S2). If he was James's son, James would have been about 24 at his birth; the 1840 household (a man and a woman each 30-40) does not rule that out. FamilySearch has no profile for Alby among James's children (S1).
